caption: The drawing depicts a pair of women’s shoes in a light blue color with soft pink and white accents. The upper section of the composition shows a side view of a single shoe characterized by an open-back slip-on mule style with a modest, curved heel and a prominent decorative ruffle bow on the front, made from layers of blue and pink ribbon or fabric. The shoe has a rounded toe and an ornate trim along the upper edge, consisting of a wavy pink line bordered with white. The lower section of the drawing displays a top-down view of both shoes placed side by side; the toe boxes are square, and the ruffled bows on both are prominently visible, colored in shades of blue and pink with delicate, translucent textures. The shoes appear to be drawn or painted with watercolor or a similar medium on an off-white, slightly textured background that has some visible aging and faint stains.
title: Shoes
